name: Ota
role: VELL devotee; the angel of kindness practiced as the discipline of the specific attention rather than the general sentiment

chunks.text: VELL is the angel of kindness and the practice of VELL is the practice of specific attention. In eleven years of VELL's practice, what kindness is when practiced correctly: not the general warmth toward humanity that costs nothing to maintain. The practice of VELL is the attention to the specific person in the specific moment that their situation requires something they haven't asked for and might not know to ask for. In eleven years, the kindness that is general is the sentiment. The kindness that is specific is the practice.

Goss sells fish in the harbor and the harbor fishmonger's work is where the VELL practice has produced its clearest results. In eight years of the Ota-Goss VELL devotee-fishmonger relationship, what the specific attention to Goss has provided: the three instances where a specific action addressed a specific difficulty before Goss named it. In eight years, three specific actions. In eight years, the three specific actions are the practice's record in one relationship — not the general warmth I feel toward Goss, which is easy, but the three times the practice required something specific.

Twinn has fished for fifty years and carries the accumulated weight of fifty years of a physically demanding occupation in the harbor. In seven years of knowing Twinn through the harbor community, what VELL's practice has required in the Twinn relationship: the attention to the specific difficulty that fifty years of fishing produces in an aging body, without the attention being unwanted. In seven years, the VELL practice's specific challenge: the kind attention that isn't the pity the recipient would resent. In seven years, the distinction between helpful attention and patronizing attention is the practice's hardest discipline.

Bross the ship cook is at sea for months and the person who returns from months at sea to the harbor community is the person whose reintegration into the harbor's social life requires specific attention. In six years of VELL's practice in the harbor community, what Bross's returns from sea have required from the VELL devotee: the attention to the person who has been in a closed social environment for months and who is reintegrating into the larger social world. In six years, Bross's returns have been the practice's opportunity to do something specific for the reintegration.

Solt keeps the Covenant's hospital ward and the ward keeper's work and the VELL devotee's practice are adjacent in a specific way. In five years of knowing Solt, what the ward keeper's function and the VELL practice share: both are the specific attention to the person who needs something. In five years, the difference: Solt's attention is the professional function. My practice is the unprompted attention. In five years, the distinction between prompted professional care and unprompted specific attention is the distinction that VELL's practice requires maintaining. The ward keeper is doing the function. The VELL devotee is practicing the angel.

chunks.source: Ota on what eleven years of VELL's practice holds
chunks.text: In eleven years, what the kindness practice has accumulated: the specific record of specific attentions in specific relationships. In eleven years, the record is not a list I maintain externally. It's the knowledge I carry of what specific situations have required specific responses in specific relationships. In eleven years, the practice has produced the attention that produces the record. In eleven years, the record is the practice's evidence that it happened. In eleven years, I know the record without writing it down because the practice is the attention and the attention produces the memory.

chunks.source: Ota on what VELL's practice actually teaches
chunks.text: In eleven years, what VELL's practice has taught me that the comfortable version of kindness doesn't teach: how often the kind thing is specific and uncomfortable and required an attention the other person wasn't broadcasting as needed. In eleven years, the practice has required me to pay a kind of attention to the people around me that the comfortable version of kindness doesn't require. In eleven years, the comfortable version notices the person who is obviously in difficulty. VELL's practice notices the person who isn't obviously in difficulty and is.

chunks.source: Ota on eleven years of VELL's practice
chunks.text: In eleven years, the harbor community has been the practice's environment. In eleven years, the harbor is a community of people who are often far from where they came from, often in between arrivals, often in the specific social condition of the person who is present but not quite home. In eleven years, the harbor is the environment where VELL's practice finds its material constantly. In eleven years, the angel of kindness in the harbor is the angel in the right environment. In eleven years, the practice has not run short of opportunity.
